claims.claim: Independent X11/WebRTC tool explicitly cites MobileIE inspiration in two comments; pinned Aug4 commit packages version1.0.0
claims.limitation: Not official MobileIE implementation, paper authorship, new citing paper or exact first publication date.

claims.claim: Actual core is handwritten YUV/USM with piecewise gain and global-statistic adaptation, without MobileIE learned network/weights/training
claims.limitation: Inspiration comments do not establish FST/HDPA fidelity; cannot equate binary size with model size or runtime memory.

claims.claim: Global MAD compares current input Y with previous final enhanced Y (or skipped raw Y); no motion alignment/history-pixel fusion/future frame read in core
claims.limitation: MAD confounds motion, exposure, noise and self-enhancement; perceptual impact unknown, not proof temporal flicker eliminated.

claims.claim: Motion recurrence reaches early-return factor<16 at integer MAD14; current frame enhancement is then bypassed
claims.limitation: Source-expression calculation only; no running application or validated visual quality/efficiency gain.

claims.claim: SIMD and scalar tail tone-curve masks select opposite conditions; nonlinear selected-segment expressions differ for23of256 values

anchors.locator: mask truth table and mismatch list

claims.limitation: Not compiled wide-crate equivalence emulation or end-to-end pixel/visual measurement; spatial/temporal severity unmeasured.

claims.claim: The named denoise blend is an identity for its u8 inputs because nonzero weight occurs only when Y equals blur
claims.limitation: Only this blend stage is covered; blur/other gains still can change noise, no denoising benchmark performed.

claims.claim: Global luminance table jumps262to448 Q8 at avgY31to32, and saturation boost is applied only on specific modulo8 frames under conditions
claims.limitation: No claim visible exposure/color flicker was observed; integer average adjustment may be zero.

claims.claim: Initial prev seed reads pool-backed I420 before successful current capture populates it; set_len is used before that read
claims.limitation: No crash test, execution, exploit or full Rust memory-safety audit; not evidence current server/task is affected.

claims.claim: Actual defaults depend on needs_scaling; three video tasks and two capacity2 queues differ from README four-stage/capacity4 description
claims.limitation: Default24fps and request pacing not measured throughput; drop/repeat and internal state evolution complicate displayed temporal metrics.

claims.claim: README hardware-level encoding/7.9MB/performance claims lack scientific benchmark support; source uses OpenH264 from_source and one encoder thread
claims.limitation: No hardware encoder proof, phone runtime, overall CPU threading, peak memory/latency/energy or quality comparison validated.

claims.claim: Pinned package includes Apache2.0 license and Cargo.lock, but no scientific data/models/results; workflow updates lock before publish
claims.limitation: No legal interpretation, third-party license/build/dependency audit or pass claim; absent scientific artifacts are not a download failure.

claims.claim: Useful traditional engineering comparator and evidence checklist; does not establish a solved learned MobileIE-video method or scientific novelty
claims.limitation: Proposed matched codec/input/strength/state/SIMD controls remain future Gate3 work; no proven gain or temporal/phone measurement.
